parole.significato: black henbane, Hyoscyamus niger, a toxic plant
parole.testo: Inherited from Old Swedish bölmeyrt. Compound of bolma (unkown) + ört (“herb”). The meaning of bolma in this case is unknown. Possibly related to Welsh bilinuntia and Belenus. See also lake Bolmen whose etymology may be derived from Old Swedish *bolmber (“large; expansive”). First attested in 1628.
